nodes.label: Points/Lines Fold Swoop (Module 1)
nodes.rationale: The shared engine's held-angle dolly replaced by animateFoldSwoop/snapFoldSwoop on the dual-camera stack: forward engages the ortho camera and glides it front-on to the flattened sheet morphing perspective to ortho on the easeFold curve; drives both Module 1 sims (Points via main.js, Lines via lines.js).

nodes.label: Lines Side-by-Side Compare Split
nodes.rationale: Opening Lines Compare collapses the step panel and docks the True Length/distance/angle sliders in a slim strip beneath the two drawings (live 3D left, 2D orthographic right) for a true 50/50 split, replacing the floating PiP card that hovered over the 3D view.

nodes.label: HT/VT Trace Markers
nodes.rationale: HT/VT trace markers now appear in the live 3D scene during the 'Show Traces' walkthrough — a teal dot where the line pierces HP, an amber dot where it pierces VP, each with a dashed extension — so traces read in 3D, not only in the 2D construction (off-sheet traces suppressed).

nodes.label: Lines 5-Step Problem-Solving Stepper
nodes.rationale: The Lines sim reworked into a 5-step stepper (True Length, Distance from HP/VP, Inclinations, Generate Orthographic Projections, Draw Traces) built on one general line the learner sets up, each step exposing only its own control, replacing six fixed-orientation exploration steps.

nodes.label: N.D. Bhatt / K.C. John Textbook Problem Sets
nodes.rationale: Authentic N.D. Bhatt / K.C. John textbook problem sets for the Points and Lines Problem Libraries (points across the four quadrants plus on-plane cases; lines from parallel-to-both through inclined-to-both), with flexible 'OR' answer acceptance for geometrically degenerate quadrants.

nodes.label: Dual-Camera Orchestrator Port
nodes.rationale: Ported Module 2's full camera/animation orchestrator into the shared engine — dual perspective/orthographic cameras with active-camera switching, a projection-matrix morph (projectionMorphK) for seamless 3D<->2D transitions, clip-aware auto-zoom, orthographic quick-views, and a flattened 2D pan — gated to the Points/Lines sims.

nodes.label: Points/Lines Auto-Zoom Framing
nodes.rationale: Engine hardening: the auto-zoom frames the subject on the geometry's centre so the camera pulls back linearly as a parameter grows (killing the off-centre 'exponential lurch'), and the view opens snug on the default geometry, easing back only as values grow, via Module 2's one-shot fixed-duration eased dolly.

nodes.label: Step-Card Scrollbar Pill (Module 1)
nodes.rationale: shell.css .step-card's fully-hidden scrollbar replaced with the platform floating padded pill (ADR-032): 10px WebKit channel, transparent track, --color-border thumb floating clear via a 3px transparent padding-box border, with a Firefox @supports guard. Hiding a scrollbar fails Visibility of System Status.
